text:
alex_ops: customer reporting lots of queued requests and strange cross-region routing. they were pinned to eu-west but many requests show up in us-east and then 401s when token rotates.
mira_support: seen the ticket — customer says latency spiked and then a sustained 429/503 window for ~3m. they pasted a curl trace.
alex_ops: paste of their header: `X-Redwood-Region: eu-west-1` but our edge shows TTL mismatch so traffic fell back to us-east-1.
dan_engineering: looking at routing logs — when eu-west queue_depth > 100 we auto-spill to nearest region. new wrinkle: token-cutover triggered during queueing, so requests that were in-flight got new token scope and failed. that explains the 401 bursts.
sandy_sre: logs: `region=eu-west queue_depth=128 spillover_count=342 fallback=us-east token_refresh=2026-03-01T12:03:15Z` — also seeing `sticky_session=false` for that customer ID, so subsequent requests landed in other AZs.
mira_support: customer mentions billing anomalies — they saw extra token charges during retries. we should confirm whether spillover retries are charged as new tokens.
dan_engineering: repro plan: (1) set a test account pinned to eu-west, (2) artificially throttle eu-west to push queue > 100, (3) simulate token rotation at midpoint, (4) observe status codes and billing events.
alex_ops: quick repro CURL we used: ```curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer TESTTOKEN' -H 'X-Redwood-Region: eu-west-1' -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":256}'``` then run a throttler against eu-west pool.
deploy-bot: deployment event: `autoscaler:v2` triggered eu-west throttling at 12:02:47Z — scaled down 2 nodes for maintenance window.
sandy_sre: aha — maintenance plus high tail latency created a transient capacity hole. autoscaler decision + queued backlog => spillover storm. we need to change fallback policy to preserve token scope during in-flight handoffs.
mira_support: customer wants immediate mitigation. they asked to pin traffic to eu-west or pause automatic spillover. can we do a temp override?
dan_engineering: we can add a temporary route rule: `prefer_region=eu-west strict_sticky=true` for the customer id. will require a hotfix to routing config and a quick rollback if it overloads eu-west.
alex_ops: action items: - dan to push routing override (ETA 10m) - sandy to audit billing for the customer (tokens counted) - mira to update customer with repro steps and ETA - dan to add short-term fix to preserve auth tokens on handoffs.
mira_support: messaging to customer: "we're applying a temporary routing override to keep your traffic in eu-west while we investigate token handoffs. we'll confirm billing adjustments if duplicates occurred."
sandy_sre: note for postmortem: autoscaler maintenance during high tail latency created a cascade. propose changing threshold for spillover and adding token-safety handshake on fallback.
dan_engineering: after override, initial metrics show queue dropping and 200s returning. still seeing ~0.5% 401s from requests started before cutover. we'll scrub logs and draft a fix.
mira_support: customer confirmed improved latency and fewer errors. they asked for a short post-incident summary when done.
alex_ops: closing loop: keep this thread for updates, dan/sandy update when postmortem drafted. :thumbsup:
